headlines.text: Dow futures drop while Apple's weak margin outlook pressures tech and a reported U.S. strike on Iran lifts oil, with midterm election results still awaited
Apple slides about 4% premarket on a margin outlook hit by rising memory-chip costs, while Palantir drops 6-8% despite beating estimates as contract growth slows
Treasury yields climb, with the 10-year near 4.92%, as investors weigh the midterm vote, delayed jobs data and renewed Iran tensions
Shopify tumbles roughly 15% and Dynatrace sinks 17% on disappointing results, while Grab jumps 10% after raising its full-year outlook
Prediction market traders now put Democrats' odds of winning the Senate near 75%, with a sweep seen by JPMorgan as a risk for AI stocks
AMD reports Q3 earnings after today's close, with Wall Street looking for EPS near $1.95-1.97 on revenue around $13.1 billion as data-center AI demand is tested
